ns2:section.sectionText: Through lectures and labs, students will gain a fundamental grounding in all of the essential skills of the film production process. They will learn how to navigate from the screenplay to the edited movie. They will learn through experiential learning the use of semi-professional equipment, both camera and sound, to create their own movies and how to edit them using Adobe Creative Cloud. They will work in groups of 3 to 8 people depending on the exercise. In addition, this course includes a series of lectures that will explain all steps of the film production process. Freshman who have the prerequisites will need to contact the SSC for permission to take this course. Course has synchronous (live) session.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
